say:1:1910543001:1.text: Has something happened, my dears? Your faces aren't as bright as when you left.
say:1:1910543001:1.source_cn: 孩子们，出了什么事？你们的表情不像离开时那样明媚。

choice_prompt:2:1910543001.text: Has something happened, my dears? Your faces aren't as bright as when you left.
choice_prompt:2:1910543001.source_cn: 孩子们，出了什么事？你们的表情不像离开时那样明媚。

say:3:1910543002:1.text: You explain to everyone the test you just ran, your guess about the glowing tide's power, and the worst that might come...
say:3:1910543002:1.source_cn: 你向众人说明了刚才的尝试，你对潮光力量的推测，以及最坏...
say:3:1910543002:1.male: You explain to everyone the test you just ran, your guess about the glowing tide's power, and the worst that might come...
say:3:1910543002:1.female: You explain to everyone the test you just ran, your guess about the glowing tide's power, and the worst that might come...

say:4:1910543003:1.text: To cut off the glowing tide's power for good, you must trace it to its source. You and Tolan are untouched by its effects, so you can dive in and find that mysterious Graveborn.
say:4:1910543003:1.source_cn: 想要彻底阻断潮光的力量，只能追溯到源头。你和图澜不惧潮...
say:4:1910543003:1.male: To cut off the glowing tide's power for good, you must trace it to its source. You and Tolan are untouched by its effects, so you can dive in and find that mysterious Graveborn.
say:4:1910543003:1.female: To cut off the glowing tide's power for good, you must trace it to its source. You and Tolan are untouched by its effects, so you can dive in and find that mysterious Graveborn.

say:5:1910543004:1.text: You have returned to bid everyone a proper farewell.
say:5:1910543004:1.source_cn: 因此，你们回来，正式与大家告别。
say:5:1910543004:1.male: You have returned to bid everyone a proper farewell.
say:5:1910543004:1.female: You have returned to bid everyone a proper farewell.

say:6:1910543005:1.text: You're going to dive deeper? To find the man Mister Calix spoke of?
say:6:1910543005:1.source_cn: 你们要继续下潜？去找卡律先生说的那个人？

say:7:1910543006:1.text: Don't worry, we'll make it up alive.

say:8:1910543007:1.text: Alright, but I'm coming along too!

choice_prompt:9:1910543007.text: Alright, but I'm coming along too!

say:10:1910543008:1.text: No, and not only am I going, Mister Calix is going too. If someone truly thinks another person is more important than anything, they won't stand by and watch that person get into a dangerous situation in their stead.
say:10:1910543008:1.source_cn: 不，不但我要去，卡律先生也会去。一个人，如果真的将他人...

say:11:1910543009:1.text: I don't want to stand on the sidelines anymore... Watching you lie there unconscious... Grandma and Shay crying... Everyone is trying their best, and I can't do anything... I want to be someone who can help.
say:11:1910543009:1.source_cn: 我不想再只是看着了……看着你昏睡，看阿嬷和小汐儿难过，...

say:12:1910543010:1.text: Your home... Your family... These are the things that you need to protect yourself, right?
say:12:1910543010:1.source_cn: 自己的家园，自己的族人，要靠自己来保护，不是吗。

say:13:1910543011:1.text: You're both my family too, and I won't let anyone deny it. I hate what happened! And I will not lose another family member again!
say:13:1910543011:1.source_cn: 你们也是我的家人，这点不许否认。我讨厌，拒绝，不要，再...

say:15:1910543013:1.text: Well said, my little jelly. By the laws of the Seamoon Clan, if they refuse to let you come along, just wrap your tentacles around them.
say:15:1910543013:1.source_cn: 说得好，我的小浪花。根据海月家的家规，如果他们执意拒绝...

say:16:1910543014:1.text: That's right! Even if I have to fight you both! I'm coming!
say:16:1910543014:1.source_cn: 没错，我准备好了。就算要和你们……要和你们打一架，我也要去！

say:17:1910543015:1.text: You're starting to act like someone from Kaflan...
say:17:1910543015:1.source_cn: 你……呃，你干事开始像卡什澜人了。

choice_prompt:18:1910543015.text: You're starting to act like someone from Kaflan...
choice_prompt:18:1910543015.source_cn: 你……呃，你干事开始像卡什澜人了。

say:19:1910543016:1.text: Why are you blaming me? You're not exactly perfect either, you know?
say:19:1910543016:1.source_cn: 怪咱干嘛，你又好到哪儿去了？咱们彼此彼此！

say:20:1910543017:1.text: Then, it's settled. I'll go tell Mister Calix. The Deepsea is where his family lives. He'll surely want to know the truth behind all of this.
say:20:1910543017:1.source_cn: 那就这么定了，我也去告诉卡律先生。深海是他族裔生活的地...

say:25:1910543019:1.text: I'll go, but Garnet stays in Coralia.
say:25:1910543019:1.source_cn: 我会去，但歌尼特必须留在塔拉萨。

say:26:1910543020:1.text: I've already told Grandma everything to watch out for, including all the taboos you reminded me of. The Seamoon Clan will take good care of him. Don't you worry.
say:26:1910543020:1.source_cn: 我已经把需要注意的事情都告诉阿嬷了，包括你叮嘱的禁律，...

say:27:1910543021:1.text: I must operate away from the Shallowfolk girl. Apart from that, how do we get through the glowing tide?
say:27:1910543021:1.source_cn: 我必须和浅海裔的女儿分开行动。除此之外，我们要怎么渡过潮光？
say:27:1910543021:1.male: I must operate away from the Shallowfolk girl. Apart from that, how do we get through the glowing tide?
say:27:1910543021:1.female: I must operate away from the Shallowfolk girl. Apart from that, how do we get through the glowing tide?

choice_prompt:28:1910543021.text: I must operate away from the Shallowfolk girl. Apart from that, how do we get through the glowing tide?
choice_prompt:28:1910543021.source_cn: 我必须和浅海裔的女儿分开行动。除此之外，我们要怎么渡过潮光？
choice_prompt:28:1910543021.male: I must operate away from the Shallowfolk girl. Apart from that, how do we get through the glowing tide?
choice_prompt:28:1910543021.female: I must operate away from the Shallowfolk girl. Apart from that, how do we get through the glowing tide?

say:29:1910543022:1.text: Well, with your gift... anything's worth a try.
say:29:1910543022:1.male: Well, with your gift... anything's worth a try.
say:29:1910543022:1.female: Well, with your gift... anything's worth a try.

choice:28:1:2.text: Stand still and don't move... magic!
choice:28:1:2.male: Stand still and don't move... magic!
choice:28:1:2.female: Stand still and don't move... magic!

choice:28:2:3.text: We use the same principle as Coralia's barrier.
choice:28:2:3.source_cn: 和塔拉萨的防护原理类似
choice:28:2:3.male: We use the same principle as Coralia's barrier.
choice:28:2:3.female: We use the same principle as Coralia's barrier.

choice:18:0:1.text: This is your fault. You've been a bad influence on her.
choice:18:0:1.male: This is your fault. You've been a bad influence on her.
choice:18:0:1.female: This is your fault. You've been a bad influence on her.

choice:18:1:2.text: It's good that you're feeling better.
choice:18:1:2.male: It's good that you're feeling better.
choice:18:1:2.female: It's good that you're feeling better.

choice:9:0:1.text: I may not be able to protect you.
choice:9:0:1.male: I may not be able to protect you.
choice:9:0:1.female: I may not be able to protect you.

choice:9:1:2.text: The glowing tide could kill you!
choice:9:1:2.male: The glowing tide could kill you!
choice:9:1:2.female: The glowing tide could kill you!

choice:9:2:3.text: You should stay in Coralia and take care of Grandma.
choice:9:2:3.source_cn: 你陪阿嬷在塔拉萨待好
choice:9:2:3.male: You should stay in Coralia and take care of Grandma.
choice:9:2:3.female: You should stay in Coralia and take care of Grandma.

choice:2:0:1.text: Well, there's good news and there's bad news...
choice:2:0:1.source_cn: 有一个好消息，和一个坏消息……
choice:2:0:1.male: Well, there's good news and there's bad news...
choice:2:0:1.female: Well, there's good news and there's bad news...
